notes.title: No Sweat! “Normal Mode” Update!
notes.content: [p]Hello, players![/p][p][/p][p]We’ve heard your feedback that the game felt “too difficult,” and we’re releasing this update so more players can enjoy the journey to the ending. While keeping the core fun—the fart-powered action and its satisfying punch—we’re adding a new mode that focuses on making the game easier to clear.[/p][p][/p][h1]Added “Normal Mode”[/h1][p]・Enemy attacks have been tuned to be a bit more forgiving[/p][p]・Some bosses’ durability has been re-evaluated to make them easier to defeat[/p][p]・Additional global tweaks to make revenge runs and retries smoother[/p][p]・You can switch anytime via Settings → Difficulty. Existing saves are unaffected.[/p][p][/p][p]If you prefer a tougher experience, don’t worry—the existing difficulty (now called “Hard Mode”) remains available unchanged.[/p][p][/p][h1]Other updates[/h1][p]・Fixed several minor issues.[/p][p][/p][p]If clearing the game has been tough, now’s the perfect time to jump back in and take your revenge. We truly hope more of you will reach the ending![/p]
